prose: Bloomberg reports Dallas-based Disruptive raised $10 billion to invest in AI, defense and software, doubling its assets under management and pivoting from single-deal SPVs to a discretionary fund structure. The 15-year-old firm plans to back about 10 later-stage companies with $1 billion each.
highlights: Pivot from single-deal SPVs to a discretionary fund
Plans roughly 10 later-stage bets of $1B each
